description: Tier-1 floats are owned: a statement-position discard of a throwing async call escapes, `void` included, because Node escalates the unhandled rejection while the caller sees a clean return. Discarding a non-throwing one is green.

diagnostics.message: `rejects()` is discarded, so nothing handles a rejection and Node escalates one to an uncaught exception: the body producing it was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: `await` it inside a `try`/`catch`, end the chain with a `.catch(h)` whose handler is non-throwing, or make that producer non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
